description: All hosts: 3 CVMs + 3 AHVs. Filters: Role, Host, Interface, Disk. Ping latency/drops use separate Ping filters at the bottom (independent of Role).

options.content:
**Time: 2026-08-09 → 2026-09-07 (UTC).** [Open fixed range](/d/sar-overview?from=2026-08-09T00:00:00.000Z&to=2026-09-07T23:59:59.000Z&var-host=All&var-iface=All)

**Left = CVM (~29 SAR days).** **Right = AHV (Sep 5–7 only in PE zip).** Load/CPU/Net are split so AHV high values do not hide CVM series.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.role == "cvm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cpu == "all")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pct_usr" or r._field == "pct_sys" or r._field == "pct_iowait" or r._field == "pct_idle")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

options.content:
**CVM:** 29 day files Aug 9→Sep 6 (`sar07`/`sar08` absent in zip). **AHV:** only `sa05–07` = Sep 5–7.

Interface **All** = `eth*`. Pick host to focus one CVM/AHV.

panels.title: Ping latency (ms) — independent of Role/Host SAR filters

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${ping_host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ping_kind =~ /${ping_kind:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${ping_target:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: Ping drops (unreachable) — independent of Role/Host SAR filters

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${ping_host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ping_kind =~ /${ping_kind:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${ping_target:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "drop")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sum")
